newsitem.title: TURKEY: Swiss trader sees bright future for gold options.
newsitem.headline: Swiss trader sees bright future for gold options.

text.p: Trading in gold options has a brighter future than spot trading as gold option volatility is at an all-time-low, a Swiss-based trader said on Tuesday.
"I am a firm believer that volatility will either stabilise, or most probably go up since many non-professionals are short options," said Marwan Shakarchi, chairman of MKS Finance.
"I think there are great opportunities in this type of trading especially since the volatility is at an all-time low," he told the two-day International Gold Markets conference here.
"Spot gold trading alone is not of much interest," he said, suggesting investors should also go in for trade in forwards, options and gold lease rate forward rate agreements (FRAs).

"I do believe that gold FRA trading will become progressively and more aggressively traded and that we shall have options more geared to gold interest rate exposure, such as options on gold lease rates and FRAs," he said.
The standardisation of contracts on over-the-counter gold markets makes it much easier to create new instruments in gold trading, he said, but did not give details.
